messages:
anya: quick pass — pushed a PR with the new 'Obsidian' dark tokens (hexes in the diff). pls skim contrast for charts + code blocks

samir: pulling it up now. thanks!

leo: first glance — legend text on the sparkline charts is borderline. 1px grid lines are getting lost against the bg.

aria: also seeing syntax colours cramped: keyword vs string are only ~6% hue apart. strings need warmer tone for separation.

max: accessibility note: axis labels at 12px currently fail WCAG AA (contrast ~3.7:1). target >= 4.5:1 for body text.

design-bot: visual-diff for PR #422: 4 changed images, 1 flaky test: chart-axis-contrast.png flagged (see CI artifacts) -> https://ci.internal/reports/422

anya: thanks — I'll bump axis labels + try 14px or stronger token. I'll also try 1.25px grid with a softer shadow to improve separation.

samir: for discrete series we should pick a colorblind-safe set. recommend using a modified Dark2 palette, avoid red/green pairs. example: #8dd3c7 #bebada #fb8072 #80b1d3 #fdb462

aria: for syntax highlighting proposal: keywords -> #c792ea (accented purple), strings -> #ffb86b (warm), funcs/ids -> #82aaff. that spacing helps scanning in code blocks.

leo: note on focus/hover: focus ring needs to be more visible on dark bg. 2px outline at 3:1 over bg isn't enough for keyboard users. suggest 3px with 1.5x saturation increase on accent.

max: also flag token heatmap: current gradient uses pure red -> blue; it's confusing for deuteranopia. use a single-hue sequential (teal->navy) or a colorblind-friendly diverging ramp.

anya: copying bits here and updating the PR. quick CSS vars snippet I'm testing:

```css
:root {
  --bg-900: #0b0d0f; /* Obsidian */
  --panel-800: #0f1214;
  --text-primary: #e6eef3;
  --muted: #9aa6ad;
  --accent: #82aaff;
  --accent-strong: #6b8cff;
}
```

anya: I'll run the contrast audit and add accessibility notes to the PR description.

samir: can we also tweak the toggle copy? "Enable dark mode" reads verbose — suggest "Dark theme" with a tooltip: "Reduce UI brightness and enable low-glare colors"

aria: +1 for "Dark theme". shorter and consistent with settings labels. also suggest adding an a11y hint: "Contrast-optimized for readability" in the tooltip.

leo: one more nit — charts: add a 1px inner glow for lines on hover so thin lines pop without increasing default noise. small CSS tweak: `filter: drop-shadow(0 1px 0 rgba(0,0,0,0.6));`

max: I'll run a quick colorblind simulation on the updated palette once PR lands. ping me @max and I can attach the sim images. :mag:

anya: great — I'll update PR with: bumped axis label size, swapped chart palette (dark2-like), new syntax tokens, toggle copy tweak, focus ring bump, and add CI contrast check. assigning follow-ups in the PR. thanks all :heart:

design-bot: PR #422 updated by anya (branch/obsidian-theme). CI: 2/3 green, 1 visual-diff failing (chart-axis-contrast).

samir: will re-review after CI images are updated. thanks!

leo: agree — looks good overall, thanks for the fast iteration :thumbsup:

anya: will merge once visuals pass.
